capabilities: Search notes, commands, open tabs, headings, bookmarks, folders and tags in one grouped list
Act on any result via an action panel: rename, move, bookmark, copy link, append to today's note, delete
Rank results by current context, lifting commands that act on the text selection
Run multi-step flows such as move-to-folder and set-property inside the bar with breadcrumbs
Set or remove any note property from the bar without locating the note first
extras: Part of the author's -osaurus plugin family (Linkosaurus, Scalosaurus, Searchosaurus, Slashosaurus). Works fully offline; the only outbound request is a one-time, checksum-verified OCR model download if the user opts in. A roadmap lists an inline calculator, bulk multi-select actions, frontmatter search and Canvas node results.
motivation: The author built it because the gap was follow-through, not discovery: built-in palettes find things but hand you off to second dialogs and cannot rename, move or act on what they find.
problem: Obsidian splits finding and acting across the command palette, quick switcher and search; none of them can follow through by acting on the result, so simple tasks take several windows.
summary: Unified command bar that finds notes, commands, tabs, headings, bookmarks, folders and tags in one list and acts on them — rename, move, set properties.
